授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
On-site attendance is required, while online participation is possible in the event of unforeseen circumstances.
This course focuses on the theories and general issues of citizenship education in Asia. Students interested in this course might also consider, while not mandatory, its sequel, "Citizenship Education in Contemporary Asia II" in the summer semester of 2026, which examines citizenship education specifically across a number of Asian societies.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本授業では、シティズンシップという概念とシティズンシップ教育という教育領域は何かを説明・議論し、現代アジアにおけるシティズンシップ教育の特徴、課題、そしてシティズン（市民）の理想像を議論する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: You may not know what citizenship education is, but citizenship education should have been part of the education you received. This course explores what citizenship and citizenship education is and discusses some common features of citizenship education in contemporary Asia. It covers discussions of the concept of citizenship, conceptions of citizenship in Asia, the relation of citizenship and education, and general citizenship education policies and issues in Asia. It takes the multidimensional – political, economic, social and cultural – perspective to explore the topics. The course also invites students to reflect on the citizenship education they received and to envision what citizenship education should be like in contemporary Asia.

授業科目の実施方法について.備考:
There will be reading and other assignments for students to do before class, primarily for the purpose of getting you prepared for in-class discussion.
Readings and slides are in English, while the instructor will use both English and Japanese in class. Students are encouraged to use whichever language (English or Japanese) they feel comfortable in class.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.レポート: 50%. Students are required to submit a course essay - in Japanese (2000 words) or in English (1000 words) - in the last week with the title "A Reflection on the Citizenship Education I received" to self-examine by using the concepts and referring to the issues discussed in class, the citizenship education you received in schools and in the wider society.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: Students will present and discuss their essays in the last class.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: 50%. This course intends to help students develop an understanding of relevant topics on the basis of individual experience. Students are expected to actively engage in in-class activities such as group work and discussion.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Attendance is the prerequisite for class discussion.
